rachel: Opened PR adding an internal-mirror section for offline bundles + a tiny apt/yum mirror example and cosign+sha256 verification snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5099

tony: Nice. Can you include a short systemd timer for s3-sync and mention presigned URL expiry?

mina: For PKCS11 examples, call out vendor slot numbering. Add: 'If CKR_SLOT_ID_INVALID, run `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /opt/vendor/lib.so` and try the listed slot id.'

rachel: Will add both. Draft cosign snippet: `cosign verify-blob --key cosign.pub bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz && sha256sum -c bundle.tar.gz.sha256`

docs-bot: lint: dead link -> ./install/offline.md#mirror-setup detected.

rachel: Oops — I'll restore anchor and add `sha256sum` verification example.

sre-bot: staging preview: 6/7 checks passed; DNS flake on `vm-edge-3` noted. Consider note about `/etc/resolv.conf` symlink and `--dns` fallback in installer docs.

tony: Also add a Windows firewall netsh example for KMS egress.

rachel: Added netsh and PowerShell snippets and a short note about TLS/SNI-rewriting proxies causing handshake failures. Assigning reviewers @tony @mina. Aim to merge tomorrow if green.
